description: City issues temporary permit for horse-drawn carriage pilot.
Pilot allows winter 2025-26 operations on city streets.
Administration reports pilot findings by Q3 2026.
Council requested pilot assessment criteria by January.

chips.text: Councillor Davies compared the horse carriage to the successful pedal pub amenity.
Horse carriage business operators Jackie and Rich Peelong are directly affected.
Councillor Donauer stated council was misinformed about previous similar permits.
Administration is developing a process for handling future one-off unregulated vehicle requests.
Administration committed to extending the permit for summer operations if the pilot is successful.

description: City acquires two properties for future supportive housing development.
Uses $1.025 million federal funding for homelessness response.

chips.text: Riversdale and Pleasant Hill neighbourhoods are locations for new housing.
West side communities expressed anger over perceived lack of focus on east side decentralization.
Councillor Pearce opposed due to perceived lack of decentralization and focus on west side.
Administration committed not to own or operate affordable housing

description: Acquires 1112 19th Street West and 301 Avenue K South for $700,000.

chips.text: Councillor Ford argued the study is not neutral
